parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in the same test-utility file `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTestUtilities/Harness/AudioPlayerTestHarness.swift`. The two initializers differ intentionally: one accepts `mockHTTPClient` and `mockAudioEngine` in addition to the shared parameters, reflecting two distinct test-harness configurations (with and without HTTP/audio-engine mocks). The Jaccard similarity of 0.714 is explained entirely by the shared subset of parameters (`player`, `testCase`, `notificationCenter`, `mockPlayer`, `mockAnalytics`), not by accidental duplication. Collapsing them into a single initializer with optional/defaulted parameters would obscure the intended test-setup contracts.
